reason: I'd probably try the free 14-day trial since there's no auto-charge, but my real problem is waking at 3-4am, and the comparison only measures how long it takes to fall asleep at bedtime. The one feature that targets night waking is still experimental, so I'd stick with free YouTube and the free version.
objection: The proof it gives me is about falling asleep, not staying asleep, and a phone's movement sensor guessing when I fell asleep isn't the kind of evidence I trust. There are no ratings or reviews yet to back it up.
would_change_my_mind: If the 14-day report also showed my night wake-ups and how fast I got back to sleep with the resume feature vs without, and it clearly helped, I'd pay the yearly plan.
